notice.DEVICE_BLOCKED: This device has been blocked by an administrator.

eod.title: End of day reports
eod.openOrdersBlock: Open orders with items: {{count}} — pay or cancel them before running Z

declaration.title: Cash declaration
declaration.hint: Count what is in the till for each method and enter the amounts. The expected amounts are not shown here so the count stays independent — they appear in the X report.

eod.declarationsMissing: No declaration was entered for this period.

zModal.title: Run Z report?
zModal.warning: This closes the current period and cannot be undone. The totals are frozen in a numbered report and the next period starts from zero.
zModal.willCancel: Empty open orders that will be cancelled: {{count}}
zModal.willClockOut: Still clocked in, will be clocked out: {{names}}
zModal.missingDeclaration: No cash declaration was entered for this period.
zModal.blockedHelp: These orders still contain items. Pay or cancel them first:
zModal.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? Its items will not be charged.

eod.zBlocked: Open orders with items must be paid or cancelled first
eod.zJustRun: A Z report was just run — wait a few seconds

migration.title: Import from the old iMenu
migration.intro: Reads the menu, tables and employees from the old MySQL 5.5 database and keeps them in sync. The old database is only read, never changed.
migration.connectionHelp: Connect this device to the same Wi-Fi network as the old computer, or with a USB cable (USB network / tethering). On the old computer run tools/legacy/setup-win7.bat once: it creates a read-only user and shows the values to type here.
migration.noneFound: No MySQL server found on this network. Check the Wi-Fi / USB connection and that MySQL accepts network connections.
migration.blocked: reachable, but not allowed for this device (run setup-win7.bat)
migration.fillRequired: Address, user, password and database are required
migration.autoHelp: When the old computer becomes reachable, check it and sync automatically (after your first approval below).
migration.needsApproval: Check the report below. If it looks right, press Approve and import. After that, syncing happens by itself.
migration.confirmImport: Import the menu, tables and employees now? Nothing in the old database is changed.

server.title: Server
server.help: Address of the iMenu25 server on your network, for example http://192.168.1.20:3001 . Leave empty when the app is opened from the server itself.
server.fail: No iMenu25 server answered at this address

admin.title: Administration
admin.usersHelp: Switch users on or off, change roles and PINs. A switched-off user is signed out at once.
admin.devicesHelp: Every device that signs in appears here. Allow or block it, give it a name (for example “Bar tablet”).
admin.noDevices: No device has signed in yet
admin.forgetConfirm: Remove this device from the list? It registers again the next time someone signs in on it.
admin.requireApprovalHelp: When on, a device you have not allowed cannot be used by staff. Administrators can always sign in, so you cannot lock yourself out. Devices already in the list stay allowed.

err.PIN_TAKEN: This PIN is already used by someone else
err.SELF: You cannot switch off or demote yourself
err.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active administrator is required
err.SELF_DEVICE: You cannot block or remove the device you are using
